items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: He worked with George McCullin. Sax I did myself. Shots. I worked with all those folks. The WPA band.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was Edward Johnson number one. They used to call him number one and the other was...
Big Head number two. He worked with George McCullin. Sax I did myself. Shots. I worked with all those folks. The WPA band. One time they had about 80-something other pieces in the band.
